Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS substrate screen using TMT labeling and DDA acquisition. While the biological focus is on ubiquitination, the MS assay itself was a total protein analysis of the immunoprecipitates (AP-MS) rather than a remnant-motif enrichment (like diGly) for the MS screen.

cell_lines: FLAG-tagged FBXW7α was immunopurified from human embryonic kidney 293T (HEK293T) cell and analyzed by mass spectrometry (MS)
HEK293T cells were transfected with Flag-EV, Flag-FBXW7 and Flag-FBXW7 (T439I, S462A, T463A, R465A) using PEI
scope: Eluates from α-FLAG-FBXW7 and FLAG-FBXW7 WD40 mutant (T439I, S642A, T463A, and R465A) immunoprecipitations were analyzed by SDS-PAGE and stained by Colloidal Coomassie. MS and data processing were performed by the EMBL Proteomics Core Facility Heidelberg.
Clarified supernatants were used for anti-Flag immunoprecipitations using Flag M2 beads.
